svg.title: Detect Loops: interrupt an agent that repeats itself
svg.desc: DetectLoops records each response in after_model_request and checks the run in before_model_request. Here the model called read_file(path='missing.txt') three times and got the same error each time, a repeated_result loop. With action='nudge', the default, a system prompt telling the model to change its approach joins the next request; with action='error', LoopDetectedError ends the run.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
